pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, large polygonal dark regions characterized by sharp edge gradients and high contrast against the inter-patch spaces. Morphology transitions from larger, more block-like shapes on the flank to slightly smaller, more elongated shapes towards the lower neck transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space pathways. The topological graph features frequent tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively constant across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge at the upper-right corner of the frame.

other_distinctive_markers: Posterior appendage (tail) is visible with a terminal tuft of long, dark hairs positioned over the rear flank.
